newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bond dealers seek withdrawal of records plan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bond dealers seek withdrawal of records plan.

text.p: PSA The Bond Market Trade Association (formerly known as the Public Securities Association) on Friday called on the Securities and Exchange Commission to withdraw proposals to change the record-keeping requirements for broker-dealers.
PSA said it supports efforts to create a uniform federal scheme to regulate dealer records but it said the proposals the SEC was considering were "fundamentally flawed."
The group criticized the proposals as burdensome and counterproductive, saying they would force dealers to create additional documents and set new requirements for holding onto existing ones.
PSA said the implementation of the proposed regulations would impose excessive costs on firms.
In October, the SEC published the proposed record-keeping requirements for comment and the staff is now reviewing the comments before making a recommendation to the commission.
